description: Use this when the user wants to change which Slack and Teams channels get Tenda's alerts, or asks where they go: "stop the morning summary in Slack". Change only what the user asked for; with neither send nor stop it changes nothing and says where alerts go now. Owners and admins can change alerts. Needs a Tenda account and workspace. Not for connecting a channel (Tenda dashboard, Settings, Connections) or for email alerts (use watch_tenders). Example: {"app":"slack","stop":["morning_summary"]}

app.description: "slack" or "teams" for that app's channels. Leave out app and channel for every channel.

channel.description: One channel, by its name: e.g. "bids" or "#bids" in Slack, or "General" in Teams.

only.description: true when what's sent here should go only here: every other channel stops getting it. An app or channel the user didn't mention otherwise keeps its alerts.

send.description: Alerts to turn on in those channels: "new_tenders" (new tenders that fit the company), "changes" (changes to tenders in the pipeline), "morning_summary" (the weekday morning summary), "bid_work" (bid work nobody has yet), or "all".

stop.description: Alerts to turn off in those channels: "new_tenders" (new tenders that fit the company), "changes" (changes to tenders in the pipeline), "morning_summary" (the weekday morning summary), "bid_work" (bid work nobody has yet), or "all". A channel with no alerts stays connected, so the team can still ask Tenda there.

workspace.description: The Tenda workspace to use, by name, when the user is in more than one, e.g. "Northbridge Services".

name: choose_alerts
title: Choose where Tenda's alerts go
